items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to permitting funds collected from
the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital
improvements
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7867

SPONSOR: WALCZYK
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the tax law, in relation to permitting funds collected
from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism
related capital improvements

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To allow an occupancy tax to be collected in Oswego County on any facil-
ity providing lodging on an overnight basis

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1) Allows for the collection of a four percent tax on all hotel
or motel rooms in Oswego County and provides guidelines for the
collection and distribution of the tax

Section 2) Effective date

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill was introduced at the request of Oswego County, to allow for
the collection on all hotel room and short-term rentals. The county
plans to use the additional tax revenue to promote tourism within the
county.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None to the State

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately
